data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Linn Mercy Erupts, DeadLands Keeps Firing as Lykos Fades
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Fresh despatches place Linn Mercy and DeadLands at the centre of the night's fighting. Linn Mercy, silent at the last edition, has logged four strategic-base actions in the past two hours and twenty-nine in the day, with recent fighting around Fort Duncan, Lathair, Outwich Ranch and the Prairie Bazaar; casualty and enlistment rates there are climbing sharply. DeadLands remains a live front, adding two actions in two hours and four in six, with both sides suffering more than twenty thousand casualties in a day. Lykos Isle, which flared overnight, has cooled—no action in the latest two hours after four in six. Fishermans Row and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet on flips despite heavy casualty counts. Weathered Expanse still exacts a fearful toll, with roughly twenty-four thousand Colonial and twenty-three thousand Warden casualties in a day, yet no strategic base has changed hands. Stonecradle, Tempest Island, and KingsCage, active earlier, have settled. Clahstra remains costly but static.
